brand.name: VOYARA TRAVEL
brand.target_audience: Young professionals, students, couples, families, and solo travelers in the UK & London seeking authentic, high-end commercial travel experiences.
brand.aesthetic_archetype: Editorial Luxury Travel Magazine & High-End Commercial Agency
brand.vibe: Cinematic, inspiring, serene, trustworthy, warm, spacious, sophisticated

typography.heading_font: Playfair Display / Cormorant Garamond / Serif (imported via Google Fonts)
typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans / Manrope / Inter (clean modern sans-serif)
typography.accent_mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for trip codes, coordinates, dates, and fine labels)
typography.font_loading_instructions: Import Google Fonts ('Playfair Display:ital,wght@0,400..900;1,400..900', 'Plus Jakarta Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700', 'JetBrains Mono:wght@400;500') in src/index.css or public/index.html

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#1C1E1D]
hierarchy.body_lead: text-lg sm:text-xl font-sans text-[#4A4E4B] leading-relaxed font-light
hierarchy.caption_overline: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#2A4038] font-semibold

rules: NEVER use Inter or generic sans for major headings — use Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond.
Headings max out at text-6xl (never use text-8xl or text-9xl).
Use font-light or font-medium on large serif headings for an editorial magazine feel.
Uppercase overlines MUST have generous tracking (tracking-[0.2em] or tracking-[0.25em]).

forbidden_colors: Extremely saturated neon blues or pinks

spacing_and_layout.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (2x-3x typical SaaS spacing). Use py-20, py-28, py-32 for section padding.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mode_a: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: All bordered cards must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text touching borders.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for pills and tags, rounded-3xl for hero containers

navigation_and_header.header_style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#FDFBF7]/90 border-b border-[#E2DDD5]/80 transition-all duration-300
navigation_and_header.rule_no_transparent: NEVER use a 100% transparent header without blur/background when content scrolls underneath.

components_and_interactions.hero_section: Cinematic high-resolution background photo with subtle gradient overlay, editorial display title, pill badge, search bar widget, and micro trust badges.
components_and_interactions.trip_planner_widget: Floating tabbed search bar (Destination, Experience Type, Month/Season, Budget) with autocomplete and direct search action.
components_and_interactions.destination_cards: Aspect-ratio 4/5 or 3/4 cards with smooth image hover zoom (scale-105 duration-700), subtle price tags, duration badges, and heart bookmark toggle.
components_and_interactions.travel_experience_categories: Horizontal scrollable or bento gallery (Beach & Escapes, Cultural Journeys, Alpine & Adventure, Safari & Wildlife, Food & Wine, Solo Discoveries).
components_and_interactions.why_choose_us: 4-column trust feature grid (Curated Excellence, 24/7 UK Support, ATOL/Financial Protection, Best Rate Guarantee) with bespoke icons and numbers.
components_and_interactions.featured_offer_promo: Split-layout high-impact offer card with countdown, percentage savings tag, exclusive perks bullet list, and direct 'Claim Offer' modal trigger.
components_and_interactions.testimonials_carousel: Editorial quote style with authentic user photos, star rating, verified traveler tag, and departure city (e.g., London, Manchester).
components_and_interactions.newsletter_crm: High-conversion Travel Club signup form with email input, preference tags (e.g., Luxury, Budget, Family), and instant success feedback toast.
components_and_interactions.footer: 5-column comprehensive footer with Brand Bio, Navigation, Popular Destinations, Legal/ATOL trust badges, Currency/Language selector, and 'Follow the Journey' social grid.

hero_images.alt: Positano Amalfi Coast Italy cliffside village overlooking turquoise sea
Santorini Greece white clifftop buildings at golden hour

motion_and_animations.page_transitions: AnimatePresence with opacity 0 to 1 and slight y slide
motion_and_animations.accessibility_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion in Framer Motion variants

testing_and_data_ids.rule: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, cards, dropdowns, filters, tabs) MUST include data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, multi-page interactive React frontend with seamless client-side routing (React Router) and local storage state persistence.
Implement the customer dashboard with My Trips, Saved Destinations, Saved Offers, Travel Preferences, and Account Settings.
Ensure every single CTA (Plan My Trip, Explore Destinations, Find Your Escape, Join the Travel Club, Request a Quote) opens an interactive modal or navigates to the relevant flow.
Apply Sonner toasts for form submissions, booking requests, newsletter signups, and item bookmarking.
Ensure total compliance with data-testid on every interactive element.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT make generic SaaS/dashboard layouts. Maintain the warm editorial travel magazine aesthetic throughout.
Never use dark blue gradients or generic AI-slop colors.
Use 2x-3x generous spacing between cards and sections.
Always set explicit hover text colors and transitions.
